title: Optimizer Tool for BMW Twin Turbo Engines
lead: MOC has developed a new Foaming Intake Tool (Part No. 75017) to accommodate the use of Optimizer™ on various BMW models. While the Tool is specifically known to fit vehicles with N63 Twin Turbo engines, it may also fit other models.
body: This new Tool connects at the Charge Air Temperature and Pressure Sensor located on the intercoolers.
The MOC Optimizer™ product (Part No. 16501) is sold separately.
